defs.def: when a liquid boils or when you boil it, it is heated to the point where it forms bubbles and turns to steam or vapour （使）沸腾；煮沸；烧开

ex.s: This afternoon we had rotten boiled lettuce.
ex.t: 今天下午我们吃了腐烂的煮生菜。

ex.s: Ordinary lettuce, spinach and boiled lettuce, that’s all there is.
ex.t: 普通的生菜、菠菜和煮生菜，就只有这些了。

ex.s: In the study, boiling hard water containing 300 milligrams of calcium carbonate led to an almost 90 percent drop in plastics.
ex.t: 研究中，煮沸含有300毫克碳酸钙的硬水，使塑料含量下降了近90%。

ex.s: The new study suggests boiling tap water could be a tool to limit intake.
ex.t: 这项新研究表明，煮沸自来水可能是一个限制摄入的工具。

ex.s: Burning hot hurricanes roared through the boiling waves, screaming with wild fury through the vast number of towering plasma beams, pulling up almost every tree on Earth.
ex.t: 炽热的飓风呼啸着掠过沸腾的巨浪，在无数高耸的等离子光束间狂怒地咆哮，几乎把地球上的每棵树都连根拔起。

ex.s: “The way they demonstrated how microplastics were trapped through the boiling process was nice,” Caroline Gauchotte-Lindsay, an environmental engineer of the University of Glasgow in Scotland who was not involved in the research, tells New Scientist.
ex.t: “他们展示微塑料如何在煮沸过程中被截留的方式很巧妙，”未参与该研究的苏格兰格拉斯哥大学环境工程师Caroline Gauchotte-Lindsay对《新科学家》说。

ex.t: 他们把一些米放进一锅水里让它煮开，同时做法式吐司。

ex.s: Almost 200 years ago, my great-grandmother’s great-grandmother was trying to survive yet another freezing Russian winter when she heard about a new invention called a “samovar”, which means “self-boiler” in Russian.
ex.t: 将近200年前，我的曾曾祖母正在熬过又一个严寒的俄罗斯冬天，那时她听说了一种叫“茶炊”（samovar）的新发明，在俄语里意为“自煮器”。

ex.s: In a study published Wednesday in Environmental Science & Technology Letters, researchers from China found that boiling tap water for just five minutes — then filtering it after it cools — could remove at least 80 percent of its microplastics.
ex.t: 在周三发表于《Environmental Science & Technology Letters》的一项研究中，中国研究人员发现，将自来水煮沸仅五分钟——冷却后过滤——可去除其中至少80%的微塑料。

ex.s: But in samples with less than 60 milligrams of calcium carbonate, boiling reduced the level of plastics by just 25 percent.
ex.t: 但在碳酸钙含量低于60毫克的样本中，煮沸只将塑料含量降低了25%。

defs.def: when a kettle, pan, etc. boils or when you boil a kettle, etc., it is heated until the water inside it boils （把壶、锅等里面的水）烧开

ex.s: They put some rice into a pot of water and left it to boil while they made the French toast.
ex.t: 他们把一些米放进一锅水里，然后让它煮着，同时去做法式吐司。

ex.s: They put some rice into a pot of water and left it to boil while they made the French toast.
ex.t: 他们把一些米放进一锅水里，然后让它煮着，同时去做法式吐司。

ex.s: It’s a traditional Russian water boiler that can also brew tea.
ex.t: 这是一种传统的俄罗斯烧水壶，也能用来煮茶。

defs.def: to cook or wash sth in boiling water; to be cooked or washed in boiling water 用沸水煮（或烫洗）；被煮（或烫洗）
if you boil with anger, etc. or anger, etc. boils inside you, you are very angry 怒火中烧；异常气愤
to boil and flow over the side of a pan, etc. 液体

ex.s: The next minute, the porridge boiled over and put out the fire.
ex.t: 幸好杰夫保持冷静，迅速关掉了煤气。
